items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: But this guy Butchie got me a job

ctx.x: Oh, right in New Orleans? Yeah.

Do you remember the name of the nightclub? It was Butchie, called Niggah Butchie. He had a nightclub on the corner next to Beansy. On one side it was a white club, and next door was a called Beansy club, he had a nightclub club there. Is that the fellow they call Beansy? I think he's still around. I don't remember. But this guy Butchie got me a job, he said, you don't want to, so many things, he said, you don't want to, how come you're not charged man, how come you got your band this year? I said, there's a whole…
Who was in the band? Who did you work with at the nightclub?
